base: branche de session (EWC1 et ESN1 pour les utilitaires) ; aucun emprunt aux branches soeurs
biome: Amp Plains / Plaine Electrik (Explorateurs du Ciel), arene de boss au coeur de la plaine, autel de foudre au nord
method: textures canoniques = rendu genere REFERENCE : rip Amp_Plains_entrance_TD.png passe au generateur ; decor complet et temoin sans objets edites et recales (0, 0)

reference_da.titre: Amp Plains / Plaine Electrik (Pokemon Donjon Mystere : Explorateurs du Ciel, Amp_Plains_entrance_TD.png)

generation.prompt: Use EXACTLY the same textures, palette and pixel-art style as the reference image (Pokemon Mystery Dungeon Explorers of Sky, Amp Plains / Plaine Electrik): same muted olive-yellow savanna grass (#8A916E) with fine vertical blade texture, same cool slate-grey fractured rock cliffs and boulders (#86939C highlights, #4F5359 shadows), same dark gnarled lightning-struck dead trees (#484B52). Make a NEW, larger top-down dungeon boss room map at the heart of Amp Plains. WIDE LANDSCAPE 4:3 (1200x896), zoomed out so the arena feels vast. Layout: the player arrives at the SOUTH (bottom edge center) through a narrow gorge between slate-grey rock cliffs; the gorge opens into a wide circular olive-yellow savanna grass boss arena completely enclosed on the LEFT, RIGHT, NORTH and bottom-sides by continuous massive fractured slate-grey rock cliff walls (NO northern canyon gap, NO exit at the top); on the left and right edges of the grass arena stand gnarled dark dead trees and slate-grey boulders (leaving the center of the grass arena completely open); at the north-center, against the solid slate-grey cliff wall, stands a prominent stepped slate-stone thunder monolith / altar platform. No characters, no text, no UI, no border.

Same image, same framing and pixel-art style (1200x896), but remove the 2 dark gnarled dead trees, all isolated slate-grey boulders and small pebbles inside the grass arena, and the stepped slate-stone thunder monolith altar at the top-center, replacing them seamlessly with the surrounding olive-yellow savanna grass (#8A916E) and the background northern cliff wall; keep the outer slate-grey rock cliff walls and the grass arena at the exact same pixel positions. No characters, no text, no UI, no border.

images: Game Boy Advance - Pokemon Mystery Dungeon_ Red Rescue Team - Dungeon Boss Rooms - Mt. Thunder.png
generation.prompt: Pixel-art sprite sheet on a flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF background, in the EXACT pixel-art style and palette of Pokemon Mystery Dungeon (Red Rescue Team Mt. Thunder lightning bolts and Explorers of Sky Amp Plains): crisp hard 1-pixel edges, no anti-aliasing, no soft glow, no magenta halos. Arrange 18 well-separated electric effect sprites in a clean 3 rows by 6 columns grid on pure #FF00FF magenta: Row 1 (top, 6 sprites): large dramatic forked yellow and white-yellow lightning bolts striking downward with jagged side branches (#F8F800 bright yellow, #F8F898 pale yellow-white, #989820 dark gold fading tone, like bolts 1-4 of the first reference). Row 2 (middle, 6 sprites): arched electric corona discharges, crescent ground flash arcs, and jagged electric rings that crackle around a stone monolith altar (#F8F800 and #F8F898). Row 3 (bottom, 6 sprites): small crackling electric spark stars and static electricity bursts in 6 animation poses from small pinpoint to star burst to scattered spark dots. Well spaced, nothing touching, no background scenery, no text, no numbers, no border.
generation.essais: premier essai ; 19 poses extraites sur fond magenta (6 eclairs fourchus, 3 arches d autel, 4 couronnes electriques, 6 poses d etincelles)

recalage.zones: temoin sans objets : herbe de l arene erodee de 6 px

fidelite_rip.methode: moyenne RGB par matiere, meme classifieur pixel sur le rip et sur le brut ; distance euclidienne ; seuil 35

normalization.methode: moyenne ponderee par classe (BOX), attribution exclusive par poids maximal

foudre_autel.origine: eclairs fourchus, arches et couronnes electriques style PMD generes sur fond magenta (electricite_poses.png, ref. Mt. Thunder et Amp Plains)

etincelles.origine: etoiles d etincelles statiques style PMD en 6 poses generees sur fond magenta (electricite_poses.png)
